slug: 2025-12-12 Personal data and digital rights in Togo - HAAC and IPDCP seal institutional cooperation accord

facts.fact: Africa Cybersecurity Mag, citing the IPDCP, reports the Personal Data Protection Authority (IPDCP) acting as a signatory to an institutional cooperation accord with the broadcast regulator HAAC on 10 December 2025.
facts.system: Instance de Protection des Donnees a Caractere Personnel (IPDCP)

facts.fact: The IPDCP and HAAC signed a cooperation memorandum on 10 December 2025 under which HAAC integrates data protection into its procedures and gives the IPDCP access to its monitoring room; no decision or sanction is reported.
facts.system: Instance de Protection des Donnees a Caractere Personnel (IPDCP)

facts.fact: The IPDCP signed a cooperation accord with HAAC on 10 December 2025, extending its access to broadcast monitoring.
